text:
alex: Heads-up — PR #21099 is ready for cross-team signoff. It's a small runtime eviction timing tweak + a defensive KV-cache fallback check. Also removes a KMS call path used only in private deploys. Need platform + infra + security signoffs and a canary owner for a Tue 09:00 PST merge slot.

priya: Can you drop the PR link and a 1‑line changelog? :eyes:

alex: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/21099
Changelog:
- eviction window: 2s -> 1s
- add kv-cache fallback guard (avoid NPE on cold misses)
- remove redundant KMS rotation call in private path

simon: I can take infra + canary ownership if perf looks ok. Quick local run: p95 +0.5%, p99 +0.8% on short seq. Not ideal but in range.

luca: Security quick-scan please? tagging the bot. :lock:

security-bot: Static scan complete — no secrets found. Flagged dependency: crypto-lib v3.1.2 (medium). Created SEC-4223.

priya: I can do platform review (routing + config bump). Please include a canary test plan and target pool. Also ping me 30m before merge to update ingress routes.

alex: Canary plan: dedicated-us-west2 pool, 5% traffic for 2h. Rollback criteria: errors >0.5% or avg latency +10% over baseline. Owner: simon.
Run command we plan to use:
```bash
rdw rollout pr-21099 --pool dedicated-us-west2 --percent 5 --duration 2h --owner simon
```

simon: sgtm — I'll own the canary and watch metrics + traces. Will post perf dashboards during run.

maria: I'll do security eyeballs in ~1h. Quick note: confirm KMS removal in changelog + add an audit note if it touched key access.

alex: thanks all. If security OK and infra sees no regressions, planning merge Tue 09:00 PST. Any objections to that slot?

priya: :thumbsup: from platform. Ping me 30m beforehand.

simon: :thumbsup: I'll be on-call for canary.

security-bot: Follow-up: Snyk scan — 0 high, 1 medium (crypto-lib). Ticket SEC-4223 assigned to maria.

alex: perfect — leaving this open for async reviews. ping me if you need more context or a quick walkthrough.
